title: How Jacky Chou runs 34 content sites and manages risk across a diversified portfolio
summary: Jacky explains how he buys starter sites, scales them with content and varied link building, and measures everything by payback period. The core theme is risk management: diversify link tactics, sites and asset classes, and take chips off the table.

principles.text: Judge site purchases by payback period; if it pays back before a core update kills it, you're in the green.
principles.quote: i personally calculate payback periods as like a main metric that i run our projections on so typically i buy sites with a payback period between two to three years

principles.text: Use a different link building mix per site so one link update can't wipe out the whole portfolio.
principles.quote: you're supposed to implement different link building tactics for each site because if you follow the same uh you if you have an sop for link building then if a core update hits all it's going to hit all of your sites

principles.text: Buy starter sites on ahrefs trends alone and move fast; speed of offer and escrow is a competitive edge with sellers.
principles.quote: i push for a speed that's why people actually sell to me because i i move a lot quicker than someone who's gonna be like oh let me take a look at ga

principles.text: Take profit when you feel on top of the world or when a site is too much of your net worth; selling a partial stake works.
principles.quote: it's when you're when you think you don't need to sell that's when you should sell and when it takes up too much of your net worth you should sell

principles.text: Keep sellers as minority-owner operators and give them your resources so they take the business from one to a hundred.
principles.quote: when i buy a business from someone i would keep them on as an operator as like a minority uh you know let's say uh owner and you know have some skin in the game

principles.text: Allocate content by performance: pause new posts on hit sites to fix existing ones, and double down on winners.
principles.quote: if they're hit by the core update i'm i told them to like pause all the articles where we're fixing up the existing ones before we move on to new articles and for the sites that are doing well i we like double down on them
